# `MatcherLeaked`

`Rasuvaeff\Understudy\Exception\MatcherLeaked`

**Class** — **Package:** [rasuvaeff/understudy](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/understudy/blob/master/src/Exception/MatcherLeaked.php#L14) — **Version:** v0.7.2

**Extends:** `LogicException`

**Implements:** `Throwable`, `Stringable`, [`Exception\UnderstudyError`](/api/classes/Exception/UnderstudyError)

A matcher reached a real call instead of a specification closure. Matchers
are part of the protocol that records what a call should look like; the code
under test must never receive one as a value.
